coastal.title: Vets warn pet owners after rabies detected in 2 bats in B.C.
coastal.description: A Whistler veterinarian says the positive cases come alongside a surge in overall bat encounters in the Sea-to-Sky region this year, with her clinic handling six bat-pet run-ins on Tuesday alone.

kamloops.title: Activity picks up on the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, Peachland
kamloops.description: Strong winds and low humidity kept crews busy along the southwestern flank of the fire, which has now grown to more than 22,000 hectares.

kamloops.title: Could ‘Lucky’ found in Netherlands be a Vancouver man missing since 1994?
kamloops.description: The man, who has been nicknamed 'Lucky,' collapsed on a street in Amsterdam on May 10, 2023. It was determined after he received medical care that he was left with aphasia.

kamloops.title: Japanese exchange students return to Salmon Arm after pandemic cancellation
kamloops.description: After a six-year hiatus, the exchange program between the sister cities of Inashiki, Japan, and Salmon Arm is back in action.

kamloops.title: Temporary protection order reissued for B.C.'s Salmon River watershed as fish spawn
kamloops.description: The province says the order aims to ensure enough water remains in the Salmon River watershed, near Salmon Arm, amid ongoing drought conditions and low streamflow, which threaten fish survival.

prince-george.title: 'This is our place': Indigenous mural at centre of new Prince George housing project
prince-george.description: A new mural at a Prince George housing project reflects Carrier Sekani culture and the local landscape. Created with Indigenous youth, the work is meant to make the new multi-age building feel welcoming, culturally grounded and like home.
